Implemented. All-or-nothing transaction. Any invalid item, duplicate UUID, inaccessible or deleted parent rejects the entire batch. Duplicate word values are valid. UUID conflicts return 409; replay receipts are reserved for CAM-09. Response order matches request; no pagination metadata. Related resources outside the owner scope return 404; malformed item schemas return 422.

post.summary: Apply 1?100 mutations atomically with durable replay receipts
post.description: Parent-first client mutations. operation_id and wire content stay fixed on retry. Replayed receipts do not write again. Conflict rolls back all NEW mutations/receipts/log changes in the batch; earlier committed receipts remain. 409 SYNC_CONFLICT carries an owner-scoped server snapshot. No device-clock conflict arbitration. JSON body limit is 1 MiB; the reference offline client prepares batches of at most 512 KiB.

get.description: Cursor is opaque, account-bound and validated; it is not an authorization credential. Server sequence is ordered under a per-owner transaction lock. A paging run retains its initial high-water mark; final cursor starts the next range. Log/tombstones are not pruned yet, so a full replay starts by omitting cursor. Persist records plus cursor in one local transaction.

post.description: Same owner/event ID and content returns original receipt, even after card deletion. Changed content is 409. Reviewed time is strict UTC milliseconds (year >=2000), at most five minutes ahead. Late events replay by reviewed_at then UUID. Receipt state is as of processing, not a live state lookup. score is an optional assessment percent, separate from quality.

get.summary: Summarize active card mastery, due today and calendar streak
get.description: Profile timezone defines today and all historical activity days; changing it regroups history. Streak may end today or yesterday. Due today includes overdue reviewed cards before local tomorrow midnight; new cards are separate. Mastered is a product proxy: >=3 consecutive quality>=3 reviews. Activity is the latest 30 local calendar days with events; zero days are omitted. Audit totals/streak include deleted cards; mastery/due exclude them. No query parameters.
Sorted reviewed_at DESC, id ASC. Includes events for soft-deleted cards. Offset pagination may shift under concurrent insertion; it is not an offline sync cursor.

get.summary: Pull immutable reviews through a commit-ordered owner cursor
get.description: Separate reviews cursor, incompatible with deck/card cursors. Fixed upper bound per page traversal; new and late-arriving reviews appear on the next traversal. Sync cards first. Apply events, replay local states, and save cursor in one transaction. No retention/pruning yet.

post.description: Requires a verified Supabase JWT. Exactly one multipart field image, no other fields/query. Maximum 10 MiB and 16 megapixels; no animated images. 10 accepted upload attempts/minute/owner/process, one upload or OCR job at a time/process. Invalid bytes/MIME or corrupt images return 400; oversized upload 413; rate 429; busy/engine outage 503. All image data stays in memory/stdin; this endpoint does not persist a source_document. Preprocessing rotates EXIF, preserves aspect ratio, and maps boxes to upright original pixels. Contexts are segmented from recognized paragraphs, not generated or translated. OCR/language scores are not probabilities.

post.description: Public JSON endpoint. No query parameters or owner/provider/redirect fields. Passwords are hashed/salted by Supabase; no local password/refresh-token table. Requires SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY; missing configuration returns 503. Shared 30 attempts/60 seconds/socket IP/process, ignoring forwarded IP headers. Refresh tokens are opaque and rotate under Supabase reuse/parent exceptions, not strict immediate rejection of every prior token. Sign-up may send confirmation email per project settings; no confirmation emails are sent by automated integration tests.
